_about: The TMS as each golden email assumes it: one existing load per golden that refers to a load already entered. Seeded into the TMS sandbox by seed_sandbox.py. Redacted: every ref starts ZZFDE and every Intake ID starts CL-FDE- (the production pipeline skips both). Golden 2 is the same order as golden 20 but stays on its old ref, because the sandbox is the TMS as of now, not as of each email.

loads.why: PO updated: the load still has the OLD PO; the email's new PO isn't on it, so only the SO finds it
